meaning:
1) round thing, surroundings, round about, that which surrounds, that which is round
1a) environs
1a1) surrounding places
1a2) round about (adv)
1b) round table

renderings.bsb: and in the places all around
renderings.kjv: and in the places round about
of those that compass me about

elsewhere.note: He carved all the walls of the house around with carved figures of cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers, inside and outside.
He got rid of the idolatrous priests, whom the kings of Judah had ordained to burn incense in the high places in the cities of Judah, and in the places around…
It is turned around by his guidance, that they may do whatever he commands them on the surface of the habitable world,
As for the head of those who surround me, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.
While the king sat at his table, my perfume spread its fragrance.
